theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pushforward
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ push : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R.Represents Y → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ O → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), push Y ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[m + 1]) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (push Y) ∧ (push Y).support ⊆ f '' Y.support ∧ (∀ L : ℝ, (∀ y ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ L) → (push Y).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ (m + 1)) * Y.mass) ∧ (Y.boundary = 0 → (push Y).boundary = 0)) ∧ ∀ Y₁ Y₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y₂ → IsCompact Y₁.support → Y₁.support ⊆ O → IsCompact Y₂.support → Y₂.support ⊆ O → push (Y₁ - Y₂) = push Y₁ - push Y₂
